intro: Master Gadrin gives you a parchment to read at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep in the Witherbark realm of the Hinterlands, to summon Shadra the spider god. Her venom is then to be carried to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take his parchment, and read it at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep within the witherbark realm in the Hinterlands. This will summon Shadra the spider god.
